citation.title: Lipid accumulation product (LAP) as a potential index to predict risk of insulin resistance in young, non-obese Asian Indian males from Southern India: observations from hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp studies

population.description: 108 non-obese young Asian Indian men from the Vellore birth registry (enrolled aged 18 to 22 years); individuals with prediabetes, impaired fasting glucose and dyslipidaemia were excluded and the paper calls the cohort normoglycaemic. Age and BMI are Table 1 mean±SD (Table 1: 'Values are presented as mean±SD or median'; these two rows carry no asterisk).

protocols.name: fasting_clamp_morning
protocols.description: Baseline sample of the clamp morning (Table 1): participants reported at 07:00 after an overnight fast of 8 hours after supper, no beverages; baseline blood drawn before the clamp, at a time the paper does not give, so a 30-minute fasted arm read at minutes 29-30 stands for it. Blood pressure in Table 1 is from the baseline medical assessment; its time and state are not printed and it is read on the same short fasted arm.

findings.description: Fasting plasma glucose (baseline sample of the clamp morning), mean (SD), n=108
Systolic blood pressure at baseline assessment, mean (SD), n=108; time of measurement not printed
Diastolic blood pressure at baseline assessment, mean (SD), n=108; time of measurement not printed

left_out.what: M value 10.3±3.8 mg/kg/min over 60-120 min of the 2 h euglycaemic clamp (Table 2): the paper prints only the insulin infusion rate (40 mU/kg/min in Methods, 40 mU/m2 elsewhere in the text) and no plasma insulin during the clamp, although it says insulin was sampled at the end of the clamp
clamp-period plasma insulin and glucose (sampled in the last 30 min of the clamp per Methods) are not printed in any table
postprandial glucose 100.5±21.2 mg/dL and postprandial insulin 37±29 pmol/L (Table 1): a single sample after food the paper does not describe
fasting insulin (Table 1): marked with an asterisk as a median, with a spread whose kind the paper does not state
fasting and postprandial C-peptide in ng/mL (Table 1)
LAP index, HOMA-IR, QUICKI, fasting glucose-insulin ratio (Table 2) and Spearman correlations, ROC AUCs and cut-offs of these indices with the M value (Tables 3 and 5)
